run_api_inference_cli: run the api_inference CLI module with --api-key and --provider flags to launch a Gradio inference interface
run_llama_inference_gradio: run the LlamaInference class to launch a Gradio UI for chat completions via the Llama or OpenAI API provider
create_llama_inference_client: create a LlamaInference instance with an API key and provider to call chat completions on Llama or OpenAI-compatible endpoints
infer_llama_chat_completion: infer a chat completion by calling LlamaInference.infer with user input text and a model ID string
launch_gradio_interface: launch a Gradio interface for LLM inference using LlamaInference.launch_interface with Llama or OpenAI provider defaults
